tool_calls.name: edit
tool_calls.arguments: {"new":"It was the kozuka drawn from his sword.","old":"It was the little knife drawn from his sword.","reason":"Japanese has 刀の小柄, the kozuka, a different blade from the 小刀 small knife he uses underwater; conflating them breaks the object continuity.","replace_all":false}

tool_calls.name: edit
tool_calls.arguments: {"new":"his muttering rang out as plain as if close at hand","old":"his muttering rang out as plain as if beside us","reason":"Japanese 手に取るように means as if at hand; 'beside us' invents a first-person narrator not in the source.","replace_all":false}

tool_calls.name: edit
tool_calls.arguments: {"new":"Guilty though the men they bound may have been, that the capture-ropes which had bound men to rob them of their freedom should now serve as ferry ropes to help men on their way","old":"Guilty men or no, that the capture-ropes which had bound men to rob them of their freedom should now serve as ferry ropes to help men on their way","reason":"Japanese 罪有る者とは云え concedes the bound men were guilty; 'guilty or no' reverses that concession.","replace_all":false}

tool_calls.name: edit
tool_calls.arguments: {"new":"her stage-style bunkin high shimada","old":"her stage-style bunkin takashimada","reason":"Same Japanese term 文金高島田 as at its first description; keep one English form for the hairstyle throughout.","replace_all":false}

tool_calls.name: edit
tool_calls.arguments: {"new":"The weeds and the water-caltrops entangle your hands and feet","old":"The weeds and the water-chestnuts entangle your hands and feet","reason":"Japanese 菱 is the same plant rendered 'water-caltrops' a page later; use one term so the weed network reads as one thing.","replace_all":false}
